name: watchkita
description: WatchKITA - cinematic movie and TV discovery powered by the Watchmode API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,red "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
